recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的造血組織中散在多顆大型巨核細胞，細胞質豐富、核分葉，數量看起來增加但未形成緊密聚集，也沒有纖維化或異常浸潤，搭配臨床血小板低下符合免疫性血小板減少症（ITP）的骨髓表現。
features: Increased numbers of large megakaryocytes with abundant eosinophilic cytoplasm scattered singly through the marrow space
Megakaryocyte nuclei lobated without obvious hyperchromatic, bulbous or cloud-like atypia; no tight clusters at this power
Cellular marrow with admixed erythroid and granulocytic precursors and interspersed fat spaces
Two bony trabeculae present; no fibrosis, granulomas or abnormal lymphoid aggregates evident
Section is fragmented with some crush/retraction artifact at the edges
describe_en: Bone marrow biopsy section shows cellular hematopoietic marrow between bony trabeculae, with trilineage hematopoiesis and interspersed adipocytes. Megakaryocytes appear increased in number and are distributed singly without tight clustering; they are large with abundant cytoplasm and lobated nuclei lacking marked atypia. No fibrosis, granulomas or infiltrating neoplastic population is identified in this field, although the section is fragmented. In the setting of isolated thrombocytopenia, findings are consistent with a peripheral consumptive process such as immune thrombocytopenia (ITP).

ddx.vs: MPN shows large hyperlobulated or atypical megakaryocytes in loose clusters with a high platelet count, whereas ITP has non-clustered, morphologically unremarkable megakaryocytes with thrombocytopenia.
MDS megakaryocytes are small hypolobated or separated-lobe forms with dyspoiesis in other lineages, not the normal-appearing large megakaryocytes seen here.
Marrow can look identical; distinction relies on lifelong history, giant platelets on smear, family history and genetic testing rather than biopsy morphology.
